results.title: APSC CCE 2024 Exam - Competition - Careers360
results.content: **APSC CCE Preliminary Exam Application Details** **APSC CCE Main Exam Application Details** Candidates qualifying the preliminary examination are required to fill separate APSC CCE application form for the mains exam. The written examination as per APSC exam pattern consists of General English, General Studies, Optional Subject 1  and Optional Subject 2. **APSC CCE Preliminary Exam Admit Card** The APSC CCE admit card of the preliminary exam is issued to all candidates who will register for the exam within the prescribed dates of application. **APSC CCE Main Exam Admit Card** APSC admit card for mains exam is issued to candidates selected based on their performance in the preliminary exam. **APSC CCE Preliminary Exam Result** On the basis of APSC CCE result of preliminary examination, candidates are selected for the mains exam. **APSC CCE Main Exam Result** The APSC CCE 2024 exam fee is Rs 250 for General/EWS candidates and Rs 150 for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC candidates. Whereas, the APSC CCE Mains exam has 8 subjects.

results.title: Major TVET Events
results.content: **International Conference on Technical and Vocational Education and Training (ICTVET2026)** The theme for ICTVET2026 is “Innovative pathways and best practices for the promotion of TVET for entrepreneurship and youth employment”. **4th Annual TVET & Higher Education Conference & Expo 2026** This year’s conference is convened under the thought-provoking theme: “Creating Citizens, Developing Skills: TVET, Universities, Technology and the Future of Democracy.” This event brings together educators, policymakers, researchers, industry leaders, and students to engage in critical dialogue and share insights on the evolving role of education in shaping the future of work and citizenship. **ATUPA International Conference, hosted by the University of South Africa - UNEVOC Centre** The ATUPA international conference will explore how TVET can be leveraged to drive sustainable development, foster economic integration and respond to the demands of Industry 4.0. **UNEVOC Conference / Seminar on Reform and Development of TVET and Strategies for Developing TVET Teacher Education with Reference to Mozambique**
